table_separation.decision: Use separate unified_customers and unified_orders tables.
table_separation.rationale: A customer can have many orders, so separate tables avoid repeating customer attributes on every order.

name_strategy.decision: Keep full_name; do not split first_name and last_name in the MVP.
name_strategy.rationale: Name structures differ across languages and cultures, and the sources do not provide reliable components.

amount_strategy.decision: Keep amount_original and currency_code, and calculate nullable amount_usd.
amount_strategy.rationale: The original value remains auditable while a common USD amount enables comparison when a dated exchange rate exists.

status_strategy.decision: Keep status_raw and map it to a controlled order_status enum.
status_strategy.rationale: Canonical values support analytics, while the raw value preserves evidence for review and remapping.

tables.name: unified_customers
tables.grain: One row per customer within a source system.

fields.name: unified_customer_id
fields.description: Generated identifier for a customer in the unified model.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Generated during onboarding for every customer source.

fields.rationale: A generated key avoids collisions when different systems reuse the same customer ID.

fields.name: source_system
fields.description: System or customer dataset from which the record originated.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Assigned during ingestion for Customers A, B, and C.

fields.rationale: Required for provenance and to make source identifiers unambiguous.

fields.name: source_customer_id
fields.description: Customer identifier exactly as represented by the source.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Preserves the source key for traceability and joins back to source data.

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: Customer's complete name in the source-provided form.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Kept as one field because reliably splitting names is difficult across cultures and languages.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Customer email address.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Nullable because source records may omit an email or contain an unusable value.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Customer phone number, retaining the cleaned international representation when available.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Nullable because phone values are missing in some source records and formats vary.

fields.name: signup_date
fields.description: Date on which the customer registered with the source system.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Nullable because the original examples contain an invalid signup date that cannot be converted safely.

fields.name: customer_segment
fields.description: Source-defined customer segment or group.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Nullable because this concept is not supplied by every customer source.

fields.name: loyalty_tier
fields.description: Customer loyalty-program tier.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A.

fields.rationale: Nullable because only sources with a loyalty program provide it.

tables.name: unified_orders
tables.grain: One row per order within a source system.

fields.name: unified_order_id
fields.description: Generated identifier for an order in the unified model.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Generated during onboarding for every order source.

fields.rationale: A generated key prevents collisions between source order identifiers.

fields.name: source_system
fields.description: System or customer dataset from which the order originated.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Assigned during ingestion for Customers A, B, and C.

fields.rationale: Required for provenance and to make source identifiers unambiguous.

fields.name: source_order_id
fields.description: Order identifier exactly as represented by the source.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Preserves the source key for reconciliation and traceability.

fields.name: unified_customer_id
fields.description: Resolved link to the matching row in unified_customers.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Derived by matching source_system and source_customer_id to unified_customers.

fields.rationale: Nullable until source_system and source_customer_id successfully resolve to a unified customer.

fields.name: source_customer_id
fields.description: Source customer identifier associated with the order.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Required because every order in the original examples supplies this relationship key.

fields.name: order_date
fields.description: Date on which the order was placed.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Nullable because invalid or missing source dates cannot always be converted safely.

fields.name: amount_original
fields.description: Order amount in its original transaction currency.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Preserves the authoritative source amount; nullable when a value is missing or invalid.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.description: ISO-style currency code for amount_original.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Conditionally required whenever amount_original is present; nullable only when the amount is absent or unusable.

fields.name: amount_usd
fields.description: Order amount converted to US dollars.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Calculated from amount_original, currency_code, order_date, and an exchange-rate source.

fields.rationale: A calculated field supports comparison, but remains nullable until a dated exchange rate is available.

fields.name: status_raw
fields.description: Unchanged order status supplied by the source.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Directly supplied by Customer A, Customer B, Customer C.

fields.rationale: Preserves the original value for auditing and future mapping corrections.

fields.name: order_status
fields.description: Normalized order status used consistently across all sources.

source_coverage.coverage_note: Derived from each source's raw order-status field.

fields.rationale: A controlled enum supports reliable reporting; unknown safely captures unmapped values.
